messages.subject: Documentation for the test_grad option in stan()
parts:
Could someone point me to the documentation for the test_grad option in stan().  It is not listed when I submit "args(stan)" nor can I find the string "test_grad" in the stan-reference-2.6.2.  There have been a number of posts here about this option, and I can sort of figure out what it is doing.  But I'd love to be able to be sure that I understand how to interpret the printout. 

Many thanks in advance.

Larry Hunsicker

messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: Re: Documentation for the test_grad option in stan()
parts:
It is under the ... argument in the help page for stan()

Another parameter is test_grad (TRUE or FALSE). If test_grad=TRUE, Stan will not do any sampling. Instead, the gradient calculation is tested and printed out and the fitted stanfit object is in test gradient mode. By default, it is FALSE.

Ben
